title: Targeting the histone-fold dimerization interface of oocyst rupture proteins from Plasmodium berghei for antimalarial inhibitor discovery.
authors: Ballabio, Federico; Bertaso, Chiara; Villa, Marta; Livero, Ophelia; Del Cont Bernard, Alessandro; Russo, Rosaria; Gessmann, Renate; Siden-Kiamos, Inga; Preira, Claude Marie Francois; Kumawat, Amit; Gabrieli, Paolo; Camilloni, Carlo; Curra, Chiara; Masiero, Simona; Nardini, Marco; Gourlay, Louise J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究疟原虫卵囊破裂蛋白HFD二聚化界面的结构及环肽抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Dimerization between the histone-fold domains (HFD) of two Plasmodium Oocyst Rupture Proteins (ORP1 and ORP2) is essential for oocyst rupture in the Anopheles mosquito vector host, representing a key event in parasite transmission to humans. Notably, ORPs are a rare example of HFD-containing proteins that operate outside the nucleus and that lack DNA-binding functions, typically associated with core histones and transcription factors hosting deviant histones. ORP HFD heterodimerization occurs at the outer capsule of the oocyst, immediately prior to rupture, thus providing a temporal window to administer dimerization blocking molecules. In this context, we present the first detailed structural analysis of the HFD ORP heterodimer, solved by X-ray crystallography at 3.1 A resolution, and analyze the oligomerization interface as a possible druggable target. Targeting the mosquito phase of the parasite lifecycle remains an under-exploited avenue as present antimalarial therapies mainly target the human blood stages of infection. We employed a GAL4-based yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) combinatorial library of cyclic peptides (CPs) to identify six candidates that inhibit dimerization in vitro. Molecular docking simulations confirmed that all six CPs bind at the dimer interface, allowing us to rank them for further in vivo testing of their efficacy in blocking oocyst rupture.
abstract_zh: 两个疟原虫卵囊破裂蛋白（ORP1和ORP2）的组蛋白折叠结构域（HFD）之间的二聚化对于按蚊媒介宿主中的卵囊破裂至关重要，代表了寄生虫向人类传播的关键事件。值得注意的是，ORPs是含HFD蛋白中罕见的例子，这些蛋白在细胞核外发挥作用，且缺乏通常与核心组蛋白和携带变异组蛋白的转录因子相关的DNA结合功能。ORP HFD异源二聚化发生在卵囊外囊上，紧接破裂之前，从而为施用二聚化阻断分子提供了一个时间窗口。在此背景下，我们首次展示了HFD ORP异源二聚体的详细结构分析，该结构通过X射线晶体学在3.1 Å分辨率下解析，并分析了寡聚化界面作为可能的药物靶点。针对寄生虫生命周期的蚊媒阶段仍是一条未被充分利用的途径，因为目前的抗疟疗法主要针对感染的人体血液阶段。我们采用基于GAL4的酵母双杂交（Y2H）组合环肽（CPs）文库，筛选出六个在体外抑制二聚化的候选分子。分子对接模拟证实所有六个CPs均结合于二聚体界面，使我们能够对它们进行排序，以进一步进行体内测试其阻断卵囊破裂的功效。
